_comment: Who may open which guide. Each audience's password is a Cloudflare secret, named below (the name, never the password). List audiences from least to most privileged: a password that matches several opens the first. 谁可以打开哪份导览：每个受众的密码是 Cloudflare 里的一个 secret，这里只写它的名字，不写密码。受众按权限从低到高排列。See docs/GUIDES.md.
_tiles: Street-level map tiles (Plan IGN, fetched by the Worker) for a guide: the area they cover as [west, south, east, north] in degrees, usually the region view's area. Only numbers here, never a place. 街道级地图瓦片（Plan IGN，由 Worker 代取）的覆盖范围：[西, 南, 东, 北]，单位为度，一般就是大区底图的范围。这里只写数字，不写地点。
_moved: Old addresses that still work: /guides/<old>/… goes to the guide's address now, for good, and suggestions sent under the old name still reach the guide. A guide's address is <city>-<yyyy>-<mm> and never changes once shared (docs/GUIDES.md, section 12); add a line here only if one ever has to. 旧地址：/guides/<旧名>/… 永久转到导览现在的地址，用旧名发来的推荐也照样送到这份导览。导览地址写作 <城市>-<年>-<月>，一经分享就不再改（docs/GUIDES.md 第12节）；只有地址不得不改时才在这里加一行。
_kinds: What a reader can choose to see: the tabs of the log-on box, in this order, and the groups of File ▸ Open Guide. Each guide names its own in guide.json "kinds", its main one first. The labels show before the password, so keep them neutral. 读者可以选择看什么：密码对话框上的选项卡（按这里的顺序）和“文件 ▸ 打开导览”里的分组。每份导览在 guide.json 的 "kinds" 里写明自己属于哪一类，主要的放在最前面。这些名称在输入密码前就会显示，请保持中性。
